title: El Metro to Suspend Bus and Paratransit Service on Thanksgiving Day
excerpt: El Metro Transit will suspend fixed-route bus and El Lift paratransit service on Thursday, Nov. 26, for Thanksgiving Day.
content:
El Metro Transit will suspend fixed-route bus service and El Lift paratransit service on Thursday, Nov. 26, in observance of Thanksgiving Day.

Customer Service and the Administrative Office will also be closed on Thursday, Nov. 26. Fixed-route bus and El Lift service will resume regular hours on Friday, Nov. 27. The offices will reopen on Monday, Nov. 30, so there will be no customer-service phone support over the weekend after Thanksgiving.

El Metro encourages riders to plan their trips around the closure. Route and schedule information is available at elmetrotransit.com and through the El Metro mobile app. Customer Service can be reached at (956) 795-2280.

City of Laredo offices are also closed Nov. 26 and Nov. 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday.
